dedupe_keys.name: harris county building instance population estimates by census block group

description: This dataset estimates the population of each building in Harris County, Texas, which includes Houston, linking every building to its census block group and assigning a population estimate from demographic ratios and occupancy assumptions. It was published on Zenodo on 15 March 2026 by Jikun Liu and Akhil Anil Rajput of Texas A&M University. It combines building geometry or centroids, structural and context features such as building type, estimated units and a parcel-informed class, and block-group demographic context such as persons per unit and occupancy rate. The core machine-learning table links each building ID to image crop and mask paths and a numeric population target; companion files give building-level estimates as CSV and GeoJSON and a block-group validation table keyed by GEOID. Coverage is Harris County. Access: one ZIP of about 214 MB on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: populations are modelled by dasymetric allocation, not counted, and the image sources are not named in the metadata read. Simulation uses: building-level population exposure for flood and hurricane risk and evacuation planning. Related records: the Hurricane Harvey and Ian repair permits and the American Housing Survey.
